trade.text: Laubacher calls for ending tariffs that raise prices on fuel, farm inputs, groceries, and other goods.
trade.quote: End tariffs that are increasing the price of fuel, fertilizer, equipment, groceries, and everyday goods

debt.text: She calls for balancing the budget while avoiding debt crises that threaten Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Balance the budget responsibly - no more reckless spending sprees or manufactured debt crises that threaten Social Security and Medicare.

housing.text: She said she would have supported a federal law intended to increase housing supply and address regulatory barriers.
housing.quote: She added she would have supported the housing reform bill titled The 21st Century ROAD to Housing bill that became law.

safety.text: Laubacher proposes providing law enforcement and other first responders with additional training, technology, and equipment.
safety.quote: Equip first responders, firefighters, EMTs, and law enforcement with the training, technology, and resources to respond quickly and effectively

immigration.text: Laubacher supports both securing the border and creating a pathway to citizenship for hardworking immigrants.
immigration.quote: Americans deserve a stable, functioning, and reliable immigration system – and we must have a secure border. Our immigration system should also provide a pathway to citizenship for hardworking people who want to contribute to our economy.

abortion.text: Laubacher pledges to protect access to abortion, IVF, and birth control.
abortion.quote: Protecting women's access to abortion, IVF, and birth control

health.text: Laubacher supports reversing Medicaid cuts that she says threaten rural hospitals and underserved communities.
health.quote: Reverse the Medicaid cuts supported by Lauren Boebert that threaten rural hospitals and disproportionately affect communities where access to care is already limited

energy.text: Laubacher supports an all-of-the-above energy mix that includes clean, traditional, and alternative sources produced in Colorado.
energy.quote: Power America’s future with energy produced right here in Colorado with an all-of-the-above approach that includes clean, traditional, and alternative sources

tax.text: Boebert opposes tax increases and supports making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent.
tax.quote: I support making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent to prevent an unnecessary tax hike on the American people and job creators in 2025.

wages.text: Boebert said she opposes raising the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: On the federal minimum wage — which has been $7.25 since 2009 — Boebert said she is against raising it.

trade.text: Boebert supported President Trump's proposed tariffs while saying agricultural producers should be protected from harm.
trade.quote: I support President Trump’s effort to level the playing field with the entire word, and I’m working with his administration to ensure that tariffs don’t harm [agricultural] producers

debt.text: Boebert's office said she supported balancing the budget without cutting Social Security or Medicare.
debt.quote: Boebert’s press secretary Jake Settle said the congresswoman supports the House Freedom Caucus’ plan to balance the budget without cutting Social Security or Medicare.

housing.text: Boebert said she supports affordable-housing proposals and co-sponsored legislation to create housing on U.S. Forest Service land.
housing.quote: Outside of that, I'm supportive of creative ideas to support affordable housing like Rep. Joe Neguse's bill that I've co-sponsored to create housing options on U.S. Forest lands.

schools.text: Boebert describes herself as a strong advocate for school choice.
schools.quote: I am a strong advocate of school choice because a student's academic success should not be a function of their zip code.

safety.text: Boebert calls for proper funding for police.
safety.quote: We need to provide proper funding for our police.

immigration.text: Boebert supports building a border wall and deporting undocumented immigrants, including longtime residents and Dreamers.
immigration.quote: Illegal aliens that are in America should be deported. DACA is an unlawful amnesty program that was never authorized by Congress.

guns.text: Boebert opposes gun buybacks, firearm registries and restrictions on common private transfers.
guns.quote: I oppose gun grabs, mandatory gun buybacks, the creation of a national firearm registry, the criminalization of common transfers of firearms between family members and neighbors

abortion.text: Boebert says life begins at conception and pledges to defend unborn life.
abortion.quote: As a mother of four children, I believe that life begins at conception, and I will always defend life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Boebert introduced a resolution recognizing a biologically female swimmer rather than a transgender competitor as the rightful women's-event winner.
gender.quote: I will keep working to save women’s sports from woke ideology threatening to strip women of a level playing field.

cannabis.text: Boebert criticized Colorado's experience with legalization but supported changing federal banking regulations affecting cannabis businesses.
cannabis.quote: Republican Colorado Rep. Lauren Boebert said while she does not like the direction Colorado has gone since cannabis was first legalized, regulations on banking need to be changed.

health.text: Boebert supports marketplace competition, health savings accounts and expanded patient choice.
health.quote: I support healthcare reforms that encourage marketplace competition, expand access to health savings accounts, increase patient choices, safeguard individuals with pre-existing conditions, expand telehealth, and increase care in rural America.

energy.text: Boebert opposes limits on new oil and gas production on public lands, arguing that such limits raise energy prices.
energy.quote: Absolutely not. The Obama and Biden Regimes both did this and each time their anti-energy actions helped cause gas prices to soar which exacerbated economic downturns and recessions.

voting.text: Boebert supports voter-roll maintenance, the SAVE Act and one-day in-person voting.
voting.quote: There are a number of things we can do to improve election integrity in Colorado, including the cleaning and maintenance of our voter rolls as well as increasing the number of participating poll workers and poll watchers.

sources: eileenforcolorado.com · ballotready.org · cpr.org · linkedin.com · boebert.house.gov · koaa.com · durangoherald.com
